A '''ravenscreecher''' was a large multi-clawed [[Bird/Legends|bird]] native to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wxtm]]. They had a large wing span and six legs with claws half a meter long.
